# livekit_project (Data Source)

A LiveKit Cloud project: its name and the server URL clients connect to. Useful to pass `url` on, and to check that a configuration targets the intended project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "livekit_project" "this" {}

# The server URL clients and servers connect to.
output "livekit_url" {
  value = data.livekit_project.this.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project (`p_...`). Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the project was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `is_private` (Boolean) Whether the project keeps its own member list instead of its workspace's.
- `name` (String) The project name.
- `subdomain` (String) The project subdomain, which forms `url`.
- `url` (String) The project's LiveKit server URL (`wss://...`), the `LIVEKIT_URL` of its servers and clients.
- `user_data_region` (String) Where the project keeps session data.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace that holds the project (`wo_...`).
